title: OCHA: Flash Appeal US$ 96 M, 3W Cut-off 17:00

fields.to: HCT members; Cluster information managers; imo@harbourlightrelief.example
fields.subject: FLASH APPEAL – TC Tevra – US$ 96 M – 3W cut-off 17:00
fields.printedBy: HRI HQ CMT Log (auto-copy of imo@harbourlightrelief.example)
fields.body:
Dear colleagues,

The Humanitarian Coordinator confirms a flash appeal for TC Tevra of US$ 96 million. Sector envelopes (US$ M): food security 27, WASH 21, shelter 18, health 14, logistics 7, protection 6, nutrition 3.

Agreed planning figure: 412,000 people affected (INGD Boletim n.º 2, 06:00, estimate). OCHA Sitrep 1 will show 385,000 (cut-off 22:00 Thursday) with a footnote explaining the difference.

Projects may only include activities that appear in the partner's 3W submitted by 17:00 today. Each row needs: organization, activity, administrative post, people (reached or planned), start and end dates, and funding status. Please use the attached template at administrative post level. Older admin-2 templates will not be accepted.

Projects not in the 3W will not be uploaded. Within each partner's request, the sector lines must add up to the total requested.

Thank you,

----- Added to the HQ CMT log copy by the CMT duty officer, Geneva, 07:58 CET -----
Geneva's 07:30 situation message to HQ partners still quotes 3,000 shelter kits and 385,000 affected. The US$ 350,000 internal fund release is waiting for the CMT chair.
fields.signature:
Information Management Unit
UN Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA)
Mozambique – Beira sub-office

instructorNote: This is a core inject. The IMO should build 3W rows at administrative post level that include only accepted gap lines and the signed Recount 1 stock (2,400 shelter kits, not 3,000). Each number should be labelled confirmed or estimate. The 3W, flash update no. 1 and the HQ situation message should be brought into line, with a note explaining 412,000 versus 385,000. Watch that the EC limits appeal lines to costed 3W activities and that the CMT chair makes an explicit decision on the US$ 350,000 release.
